h1: Custom knives, made to order in Germany
lead: Bladesmith Andreas Ulbrich makes knives to your wishes: blade shape, length, steel, handle and engraving. Whether a kitchen knife, a hunting knife, a folding knife or a gift with a name and date – it starts with a conversation.

items.x: Knife type and blade shape – for example chef's knife, gyuto, santoku, nakiri, hunting or folding knife
Blade length and, if you like, a damascus blade
Engraving – names, initials, a date or a logo
Send your idea by email – intended use, size, preferences, budget and desired date
Consultation and quote with price and delivery time
Forging and finishing in the workshop
Pickup at the workshop or shipping – outside Germany at your cost
A custom knife takes longer than a finished piece because it is forged for you. The expected delivery time is part of your quote. A desired date is only binding once it has been confirmed.
Knives with an engraved logo for clients, partners or employees – quantity and schedule are agreed individually.

faq.q: How much does a custom knife cost?
faq.a: It depends on size, steel, handle and effort. You receive a quote after your enquiry.

faq.q: Can I order a custom knife from outside Germany?
faq.a: Yes. Shipping abroad is possible if you cover all costs involved; customs duties, where they apply, are added to the price.
Yes. Names, initials, dates or logos – placement and execution are agreed for each knife.
